enemies.death_widow.description: A deadly spider that spins lethal webs.

enemies.moth_spiderling.description: A small spider with delicate wings, agile and swift.

enemies.fire_dragon.name: Fire Dragon
enemies.fire_dragon.description: Fire Dragons will attack from afar with large plumes of fire from their mouths. They lurk in large open volcanic caverns or mountains. Most common elemental dragon, cannot become a powerful one. Immune to air; pure air feeds their elemental core, empowering them with a super powerful fireball. A large number of fire dragons can cause catastrophic volcanic activity.
enemies.aqua_dragon.name: Aqua Dragon
enemies.aqua_dragon.description: Aqua Dragons are similar to Fire Dragons, attacking from afar by exhaling scalding hot water. They reside near or in various bodies of water. Second most common elemental dragon, capable of becoming a powerful one, but extremely rare. Those in snowy tundras exhale icy mist or icicles. A single enraged Aqua Dragon can cause torrential downpours, flooding low basins, and large swathes of land.
enemies.earth_dragon.name: Earth Dragon
enemies.earth_dragon.description: Earth Dragons fight close to the ground and manipulate their surroundings to subdue challengers. They reside in caverns, caves, mountaintops, and deep under the planet's mantle. Their bodies are amalgamations of rare minerals and metals, lacking magical scales. Powerful Earth Dragons can become unstoppable behemoths. They may offer protection from other monsters for metallic coins.
enemies.air_dragon.name: Air Dragon
enemies.lightning_dragon.name: Lightning Dragon
enemies.light_dragon.name: Light Dragon
enemies.dark_dragon.name: Dark Dragon
enemies.eclipse_dragon.name: Eclipse Dragon
enemies.lunar_dragon.name: Lunar Dragon
enemies.natural_dragon.name: Natural Dragon
enemies.natural_dragon.description: Natural Dragons are barely alive and normally very frail. They are fairly rare and often subservient to humans or demons. They can perform small tasks for their caretakers.
enemies.soul_dragon.name: Soul Dragon
enemies.soul_dragon.description: Soul Dragons are collections of many souls, with varying magical powers depending on their environment. They can manifest one elemental power and may be immune to physical attacks. Powerful ones act like local gods, manipulating terrain and influencing fate.
enemies.blood_dragon.name: Blood Dragon
